parameters.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', c.created_at)::date as cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.lead_status = 'customer') as converted, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.created_at > c.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days')) as retained_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.created_at > c.created_at + INTERVAL '60 days')) as retained_60d, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.created_at > c.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days')) as retained_90d, COALESCE(SUM(d.deal_value) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won'), 0) as total_revenue, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d.deal_value) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won'), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.lead_status = 'customer'), 0)) as avg_ltv FROM contacts c LEFT JOIN deals d ON d.contact_id = c.id WHERE c.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', c.created_at) ORDER BY cohort_month DESC
